  renames the ESM types to index.d.mts since tsup can't do that natively.
- Exports map switches to nested import/require with per-condition types,
  so TS consumers under node16/nodenext moduleResolution resolve the
  correct .d.mts or .d.cts.
- README gains a Size section listing raw + gzipped per logical group.
